blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Record-breaking rainfall. When Typhoon Tino (international name: Kalmaegi) swept through Cebu in November 2025, torrential rains triggered widespread flooding that inundated communities, damaged homes, and claimed lives. Nearly a year later, the disaster remains a fresh memory for residents who witnessed floodwaters rise rapidly, sweeping through low-lying communities and leaving destruction […]...
